question: Related Questions Q. Respected Uoolma of Dewoband! This is Nazir Ahmad from Afghanistan. I have a question for which I require your assistance and answer. Due to bad behavior with me and my 2 sons I verbally pronounced Talak thrice to my wife. She refused to acknowledge the Talak saying that there was no witness to the Talak. Thereafter I pronounced Talak in the presence of a Mufti and 2 adult muslim witnesses. The written talaknama was sent to my wife by speed post which she has refused to accept. Technically she claims to have not been divorced and her family members support her. I left my house immediately after this incident and have been living in a separate house with my 2 sons for the last 2 and half years. As per the Muslim law and the Sharia, is my Talak valid. If it is please issue me Fatwa which I can produce in court so that my Talak can be recognized. 2270 views Q. ASLK ,My brother divorced his wife some 2 years ago because his Wife Committed a Zina (illicit relationship. The local Kazi issued a Fatwa stating that husband returns back the meher, gifts and also the ruling said that the elder son who is 8 years old to stay with father and the daughter who is 6 years old to be with mother. But my brother refused this fatwa, but as per shariaah he returned back the meher (land worth around 5 lakhs) but he refused to give his daughter as well the jewel which he gifted to his wife. He said that he will give his jewels to his daugher and also said that he will not allow his daughter to grow in an atmosphere where his wife and her family character , morality is not good and conducive for child's growth. Which i feel he is 100% correct. Could you please advise me on this matter? Allah hafiz 2450 views Q. I hope Insha Allah, you will be able to advice in the right direction. Please look into the following case: One Mrs. XYZ sought Khul from her husband Mr. ABC after eight years of marital life. Mr. ABC approved the request for Khul of Mrs. XYZ and Khul took place. Before the Idda period was over, the woman XYZ realized her fault and requested again for Nikkah, which the man ABC has accepted. They got remarried as per the Islamic Sharia. Within 3 months of remarriage, the Husband Mr. ABC realized and warned her that she is not obedient and not behaving properly as a wife. Finally after a few days, the Husband ABC divorced her (XYZ) during Tohar condition one time for not fulfilling the marital requirements. Before the Idda period came to an end, the wife repented and they reconciled and got united again. Again after 5 months, Husband ABC divorced Mrs. XYZ for her not obedient attitude and for not fulfilling the marital requirements. Again the wife Mrs. XYZ said, she will try to be following the marital requirements of a wife and they got reunited again. Again after reunification, the same problems surfaced again. Now the husband wants to diverse her again. Now the question is if the Husband divorces now in Tohar condition, is it considered as first Talaq, or the Third talaq? 2101 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 33302 Country: United Kingdom Title: Divorce Question: I am writing this from UK. Yesterday during a family dispute my wife demanded divorce from me. She has been asking quite frequently but I used to leave the house to avoid such situation. But yesterday I could not leave the house and I wrote following sentence on a paper. THIS DIVORCE IS SUBJECT TO HER SIGNATURE. In fact I meant that if she signs this paper then she would be having one divorce this was my intention at the time of writing this. Later on she did not sign it. I just want to know that has this one divorce been done or not? Secondly, if it is 2nd time divorce, then is there any possibility of Ruju, because in 1997 I gave her one talaq on her parents demand? Are we still husband and wife or what is the status of our relation? Answer ID: 33302 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1476/896/H=1432) Which talaq did you mean by the sentence "this divorce is subject to her signature?" Did you pronounce the word of talaq or gave it in written form, whether you wanted to condition those said words with this sentence? And what were those word of talaq? Write it clearly and submit the question again. Also attach the copy of this fatwa, then you shall be replied in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
